text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is the paired difference in mean CRPS between an arm and production with cleaning, within one type of series, over 53 weekly ECMWF ensemble (ENS) forecast runs, scored from July 2025 to June 2026; average of seeds 0, 1, 2. Zero means no change. Each line is the 95% interval from resampling whole months. Battery storage (1 series) and biofuel (1 series) are in the all-series figures but not drawn here. The best round 2 arm, "Quantile, lead, wind, pooled", is quantile training with the lead-time column, lean wind columns, and pooling. (post hoc) marks an arm chosen after seeing earlier results; unmarked arms were planned. The breakdown by series type was not planned, so every row is exploratory.'
text.tspan: Each dot is the paired difference in mean CRPS between an arm and production with cleaning, within one type of
series, over 53 weekly ECMWF ensemble (ENS) forecast runs, scored from July 2025 to June 2026; average of seeds 0,
Each line is the 95% interval from resampling whole months. Battery storage (1 series) and biofuel (1 series) are
in the all-series figures but not drawn here.
The best round 2 arm, "Quantile, lead, wind, pooled", is quantile training with the lead-time column, lean wind
